<function name="istable" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns if the passed object is a <page>table</page>.
	<note>Will return `true` if the argument has a metatable. It will return `true` for variables of type <page>Color</page> as well.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="variable" type="any">The variable to perform the type check for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">True if the variable is a <page>table</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>


<example>
	<description>Second object has a string conversion but it is still a table</description>
	<code>
local mt1 = {}
function new1()
  self = {}; setmetatable(self, mt1)
  mt1.__index = mt1
  return self
end

local mt2 = {}
function new2()
  self = {}; setmetatable(self, mt2)
  mt2.__index = mt2
  mt2.__tostring = function(o) return "TEST" end
  return self
end
	</code>
	<output>
```
table: 0x01c98390	true	TEST	true	table: 0x019f29f8	true
```
	</output>
</example>
